title: emergency.py: Falsy timestamp 0 incorrectly rejected
description: Line 125 uses `body.get("t") or body.get("ts")` which treats timestamp 0 as falsy, causing it to fall through to checking "ts". If only "t" is provided with value 0, timestamp becomes None and line 128 returns BAD_REQUEST. However, lines 140-141 explicitly allow timestamp >= 0, so epoch 0 should be valid. Fix: use `body.get("t") if body.get("t") is not None else body.get("ts")`
